BiblicalUsage: Shedeur's name means darting of light, and he is remembered as the father of Elizur, prince of Reuben, who stood with Moses at the numbering and offered on the fourth day and led his host when the camp set forward. The father is named because the son stood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a father's name is carried by his son's faithfulness. Elizur led Reuben, and Shedeur is remembered in him.
